entries.title: Elixpo begins
entries.description: The organization begins as a college-era collection of open experiments and tools. That origin remains part of the record, but no longer limits what Elixpo can become.

entries.title: Experiments become an ecosystem
entries.description: Creative tools, search experiments, collaboration software, publishing work, infrastructure, and community contributions accumulate across many repositories.

entries.title: Shared foundations emerge
entries.description: LixSketch, LixBlogs, Accounts, Lixrl, member portfolios, packages, Oreo, and research projects establish distinct public surfaces while sharing an organizational home.

entries.title: The foundry direction is adopted
entries.description: Elixpo defines itself as an open-source project foundry: a place for active work to build in public, release a meaningful chapter, and leave a durable, attributable record.

entries.title: Chapters become the operating unit
entries.description: Repository standards, project dossiers, research records, public discussions, contributor credit, and release narratives are aligned around repeatable Chapters and independently stewarded Member Projects.
